params.message:
Werf fiche: fill in any past day, not only today

The fiche was today's and nothing else (worksheetFor(now())), so a day he
did not get to in the evening could not be filled in the next morning.

- Tapping the date under his name opens a day choice: Vandaag, Gisteren,
  Eergisteren, or any earlier date. Never a day still to come. Not during a
  call, because the voice would keep talking about the day it started on.
- A new SheetDay keeps the choice in his session for the rest of the day it
  was made; signing in, or opening the app the next day, starts on today.
  The page and the conversation endpoints both ask SheetDay, so the voice
  and the screen are always on the same fiche.
- While it is not today, a strip says which day it is, with "Terug naar
  vandaag"; the texts that said "vandaag" say "die dag".
- The prompt says the fiche is for that day and not today.
- The office sees "achteraf ingevuld" on the Dagrapport row and on the fiche,
  for a fiche created on a later day than its date: it may arrive after that
  day was already booked.
